syncFailed.subject: We couldn’t finish scanning {mailboxEmail}
syncFailed.preview: The scan of {mailboxEmail} stopped and needs you to finish it.
syncFailed.safe: Nothing in your Gmail was changed, and everything already scanned is kept. When the scan resumes, it picks up where it stopped.
syncFailed.needsYou: We tried again automatically and it still didn’t finish, so it won’t try again on its own. Open DeclutrMail to resume the scan.
syncFailed.needsReconnect: DeclutrMail no longer has permission to scan this Gmail account. Reconnect it to resume the scan.
syncFailed.permanent: This scan can’t continue. Open DeclutrMail to see what happened and what you can do.
syncFailed.footer: This is a required account notice. It can’t be turned off.
syncFailed.retrying: The scan of {mailboxEmail} stopped. We’ll try again automatically at {time} and email you when your inbox is ready.

body.one: 1 email scanned from {mailboxEmail}. Your senders are grouped and ready to review.
body.other: {n} emails scanned from {mailboxEmail}. Your senders are grouped and ready to review.

syncReminder.subject: Your inbox is still ready
syncReminder.body: Yesterday DeclutrMail finished scanning {mailboxEmail}. Your senders are grouped and waiting.

footer.connected: You received this because you connected this {CONNECTION_TERM} to DeclutrMail.

subject.one: 1 sender is waiting on a decision
subject.other: {n} senders are waiting on a decision

lapse.body: These senders, across all your {CONNECTION_TERM_PLURAL}, are still waiting for your first decision.
